stories.headline: OpenAI cancels GPT-6.1 Astra release
stories.summary: OpenAI scrapped an October release after internal tests found GPT-6.1 Astra fell short of safety and alignment standards. The company cited scope, authorization and disclosure concerns; some deception details were reported by the Wall Street Journal.

stories.headline: Anthropic founders retain control through IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic's filing creates a Founder LLC whose seven co-founders direct 50.1% of voting power. The structure is intended to protect its public-benefit mission but may sharply limit ordinary shareholders' influence.

stories.headline: Trump hosts tech chiefs for AI policy talks
stories.summary: Trump, House Speaker Mike Johnson and major AI executives meet Tuesday. Johnson says talks will seek a balance between innovation and oversight; Democrats and industry leaders are pressing for stronger safety action.

stories.headline: US forces prepare final withdrawal from Iraq
stories.summary: US forces are due to leave their last Iraqi bases Wednesday under a 2024 agreement. Iraqi officials and analysts warn the pullout could expand Iran-aligned influence and create room for Islamic State cells to regroup.

stories.headline: Russian jet-drone strikes kill nine in Ukraine
stories.summary: Ukraine says Russian jet-powered drone strikes killed nine people and injured more than 80 nationwide. Kyiv reported a 57% interception rate against the faster drones; Russia denies deliberately targeting civilians.
